raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Depends on #8026. Please review the diff from the merge of #8026 into main: [scoped diff](https://github.com/Connor-XY/Megatron-LM/compare/dffb310a5d...yx/pstate-g15-memory-buffer-imports).

**Why.** With #8026 the global memory buffer lives in `megatron/core/utils.py` and is created on first use; `parallel_state` only re-exports it. In-tree callers still reach it through `parallel_state`: the local `DotProductAttention` (looked up on the module in every forward), the tensor-parallel linears and mappings, the dynamic engine's CUDA-graph pre-sizing, training teardown and the MIMO example. They depend on the global-grid module for scratch memory that uses no process group. The MIMO example also wraps the get in a `try/except AssertionError` that can no longer trigger.

**What.**
- Every in-tree caller imports `get_global_memory_buffer` and `destroy_global_memory_buffer` from `megatron.core.utils`.
- The MIMO example no longer creates the buffer at startup. Its first user does.
- `parallel_state` keeps `get_global_memory_buffer` and `destroy_global_memory_buffer` as re-exports of the same functions, and `_set_global_memory_buffer`, which still only creates the buffer if it is missing.

**Tests.**
- `tests/unit_tests/test_global_memory_buffer.py`: the sequence-parallel linear, buffer all-gather and local-attention tests run with the `parallel_state` aliases patched to raise, and check that the shared buffer was used. Only local attention can tell the import paths apart at runtime. The linears and mappings import the function by name, so the scan below covers them.
- New stdlib-only `tests/unit_tests/test_global_memory_buffer_imports.py` scans `megatron/`, `examples/`, `tools/` and the top-level scripts for buffer functions taken from `parallel_state`. It finds 8 sites on #8026's head and none here.

Before the 2026-11-01 sync, on 4 GPUs against #8026's head: no regressions, and the import scan fails there and passes here. On 4 CPU gloo ranks, also before the sync, the import scan passes, and the same 4 buffer tests fail for lack of CUDA here and on #8026's head. In the integration run (main 77391e71cc with all #6307 PRs merged, against main, on 4 GPUs), `test_global_memory_buffer.py` passes 7 tests and `test_global_memory_buffer_imports.py` passes 3. Main has neither file, so all 10 are new tests there. In the integration run, this PR's test files show no regressions against main.

**Compatibility.** No behavior change. `megatron.core.transformer.dot_product_attention` no longer imports `parallel_state`, so the module attribute `dot_product_attention.parallel_state` is gone. Code that patched `parallel_state.get_global_memory_buffer` to intercept attention's buffer no longer intercepts it. The linears and mappings already behaved this way. Megatron-Bridge's `mpu.get_global_memory_buffer` calls keep working through the re-export. Not changed here: the stale memory-buffer remark in the comment above `DEPRECATED_PREFIXES` in `tools/check_process_group_usage.py`, and Bridge's test that patches `mpu._GLOBAL_MEMORY_BUFFER`. Needs `determinism-exempt`: `layers.py`, `mappings.py` and `dot_product_attention.py` are registered kernel files, and their edits only change where the buffer function comes from.

Synced with main 77391e71cc on 2026-11-01 by a merge commit (through the updated #8026), so existing commits and review links stay valid. The merge had no conflicts. Through #8026, the process-group allowlist records the reads main added since this PR was written.

Part of #6307.

+# Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+
+"""The global memory buffer is process-wide scratch memory that needs no parallel_state grid."""
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from megatron.core import parallel_state
+from megatron.core.hyper_comm_grid import HyperCommGrid
+from megatron.core.model_parallel_config import ModelParallelConfig
+from megatron.core.process_groups_config import ProcessGroupCollection
+from megatron.core.tensor_parallel.layers import ColumnParallelLinear, RowParallelLinear
+from megatron.core.tensor_parallel.mappings import gather_from_sequence_parallel_region
+from megatron.core.transformer.dot_product_attention import DotProductAttention
+from megatron.core.transformer.enums import AttnMaskType
+from megatron.core.transformer.transformer_config import TransformerConfig
+from megatron.core.utils import get_global_memory_buffer
+from tests.unit_tests.test_utilities import Utils
+
+
+def _own_tensor_parallel_group(tp_size):
+    """Build a tensor-parallel group directly, without parallel_state."""
+    if Utils.world_size % tp_size != 0:
+        pytest.skip(f"needs a world size divisible by {tp_size}")
+    return HyperCommGrid([tp_size, Utils.world_size // tp_size], ["tp", "dp"]).create_pg("tp")
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def parallel_state_buffer_forbidden(monkeypatch):
+    """Make parallel_state's buffer aliases raise, so callers must use megatron.core.utils."""
+
+    def forbidden(*args, **kwargs):
+        raise RuntimeError("the global memory buffer was taken from parallel_state")
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(parallel_state, "get_global_memory_buffer", forbidden)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(parallel_state, "_set_global_memory_buffer", forbidden)
+
+
+def _small_integers(generator, *shape, low=-2, high=3):
+    """Integer-valued float32 data, so that the matmuls below are exact even with TF32."""
+    return torch.randint(low, high, shape, generator=generator, device="cuda").float()
+
+
+class TestGlobalMemoryBuffer:
+
+    def setup_method(self, method):
+        Utils.initialize_distributed()
+        # No global grid and no buffer: only the groups each test builds exist.
+        parallel_state.destroy_model_parallel()
+
+    def teardown_method(self, method):
+        Utils.destroy_model_parallel()
+
+    @pytest.mark.usefixtures("parallel_state_buffer_forbidden")
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize("tp_size", [2, 4])
+    def test_sequence_parallel_linears_on_their_own_group(self, tp_size):
+        """Sequence-parallel linears run on an explicit group without initialize_model_parallel."""
+        tp_group = _own_tensor_parallel_group(tp_size)
+        tp_rank = tp_group.rank()
+        seq_length, batch, hidden, ffn_hidden = 8, 2, 16, 32
+        config = ModelParallelConfig(
+            tensor_model_parallel_size=tp_size, sequence_parallel=True, perform_initialization=False
+        )
+        pg_collection = ProcessGroupCollection(tp=tp_group, gtp_remat=None)
+        fc1 = ColumnParallelLinear(
+            hidden,
+            ffn_hidden,
+            config=config,
+            init_method=torch.nn.init.zeros_,
+            bias=False,
+            tp_group=tp_group,
+            pg_collection=pg_collection,
+        )
+        fc2 = RowParallelLinear(
+            ffn_hidden,
+            hidden,
+            config=config,
+            init_method=torch.nn.init.zeros_,
+            bias=False,
+            input_is_parallel=True,
+            skip_bias_add=False,
+            tp_group=tp_group,
+            pg_collection=pg_collection,
+        )
+
+        # The same full tensors on every rank; each rank takes its shards.
+        generator = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(1234)
+        w1 = _small_integers(generator, ffn_hidden, hidden, low=-1, high=2)
+        w2 = _small_integers(generator, hidden, ffn_hidden, low=-1, high=2)
+        x = _small_integers(generator, seq_length, batch, hidden)
+        tokens = slice(tp_rank * seq_length // tp_size, (tp_rank + 1) * seq_length // tp_size)
+        features = slice(tp_rank * ffn_hidden // tp_size, (tp_rank + 1) * ffn_hidden // tp_size)
+        with torch.no_grad():
+            fc1.weight.copy_(w1[features])
+            fc2.weight.copy_(w2[:, features])
+
+        x_shard = x[tokens].clone().requires_grad_()
+        output, _ = fc2(fc1(x_shard)[0])
+        output.sum().backward()
+
+        x_ref, w1_ref, w2_ref = (t.clone().requires_grad_() for t in (x, w1, w2))
+        output_ref = x_ref @ w1_ref.t() @ w2_ref.t()
+        output_ref.sum().backward()
+
+        exact = dict(rtol=0, atol=0)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(output, output_ref[tokens], **exact)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(x_shard.grad, x_ref.grad[tokens], **exact)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(fc1.weight.grad, w1_ref.grad[features], **exact)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(fc2.weight.grad, w2_ref.grad[:, features], **exact)
+        assert ("mpu", torch.float32) in get_global_memory_buffer().buffer
+
+    @pytest.mark.usefixtures("parallel_state_buffer_forbidden")
+    def test_gather_into_the_buffer_on_its_own_group(self):
+        """The all-gather into the global buffer (MoE allgather dispatcher) runs without the grid."""
+        tp_size = 2
+        tp_group = _own_tensor_parallel_group(tp_size)
+        local = torch.full((2, 3), float(tp_group.rank()), device="cuda")
+
+        gathered = gather_from_sequence_parallel_region(
+            local, group=tp_group, use_global_buffer=True
+        )
+
+        expected = torch.arange(tp_size, dtype=torch.float32, device="cuda").repeat_interleave(2)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(gathered, expected[:, None].expand(-1, 3))
+        assert ("mpu", torch.float32) in get_global_memory_buffer().buffer
+
+    @pytest.mark.usefixtures("parallel_state_buffer_forbidden")
+    def test_local_attention_on_its_own_group(self):
+        """The local DotProductAttention runs on an explicit group without the global grid."""
+        tp_size = 2
+        tp_group = _own_tensor_parallel_group(tp_size)
+        seq_length, batch, num_heads, head_dim = 8, 2, 4, 8
+        config = TransformerConfig(
+            num_layers=1,
+            hidden_size=num_heads * head_dim,
+            num_attention_heads=num_heads,
+            tensor_model_parallel_size=tp_size,
+            # Sequence parallelism keeps the attention dropout off the model-parallel RNG tracker.
+            sequence_parallel=True,
+            attention_dropout=0.0,
+        )
+        attention = DotProductAttention(
+            config,
+            layer_number=1,
+            attn_mask_type=AttnMaskType.causal,
+            attention_type="self",
+            pg_collection=ProcessGroupCollection(tp=tp_group),
+        ).cuda()
+
+        generator = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(1234)
+        shape = (seq_length, batch, num_heads // tp_size, head_dim)
+        query, key, value = (
+            torch.randn(shape, generator=generator, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float64)
+            for _ in range(3)
+        )
+        output = attention(query, key, value, attention_mask=None)
+
+        scores = torch.einsum("sbnh,tbnh->bnst", query, key) * attention.softmax_scale
+        future = torch.ones(seq_length, seq_length, dtype=torch.bool, device="cuda").triu(1)
+        probs = scores.masked_fill(future, float("-inf")).softmax(dim=-1)
+        expected = torch.einsum("bnst,tbnh->sbnh", probs, value).reshape(seq_length, batch, -1)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(output, expected)
+        assert ("mpu", torch.float64) in get_global_memory_buffer().buffer
+
+    def test_buffer_is_created_on_first_use_and_reset_by_destroy(self):
+        from megatron.core import utils
+
+        buffer = parallel_state.get_global_memory_buffer()
+        assert parallel_state.get_global_memory_buffer() is buffer
+        assert utils.get_global_memory_buffer() is buffer
+
+        buffer.get_tensor((4,), torch.float32, "mpu")
+        parallel_state.destroy_global_memory_buffer()
+        recreated = parallel_state.get_global_memory_buffer()
+        assert recreated is not buffer
+        assert not recreated.buffer
+
+        parallel_state.destroy_model_parallel()
+        assert parallel_state.get_global_memory_buffer() is not recreated
+
+    def test_initialize_model_parallel_keeps_the_existing_buffer(self):
+        """A buffer sized before setup (for example, before CUDA-graph capture) stays in place."""
+        buffer = parallel_state.get_global_memory_buffer()
+        presized = buffer.get_tensor((1024,), torch.float32, "mpu")

+        parallel_state.initialize_model_parallel()

+        assert buffer.get_tensor((16,), torch.float32, "mpu").data_ptr() == presized.data_ptr()

+        parallel_state._set_global_memory_buffer()
+        buffer = parallel_state.get_global_memory_buffer()
+

+# Copyright (c) 2026, NVIDIA CORPORATION. All rights reserved.
+
+"""In-tree code takes the global memory buffer from megatron.core.utils, not from parallel_state.
+
+Stdlib only. Run directly with ``python tests/unit_tests/test_global_memory_buffer_imports.py`` to
+avoid the GPU fixtures used when pytest collects the enclosing unit-test package.
+"""
+
+import ast
+import importlib.util
+import pathlib
+import unittest
+
+REPO_ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+PARALLEL_STATE = "megatron.core.parallel_state"
+# megatron.core exports parallel_state under its legacy name as well.
+PARALLEL_STATE_NAMES = {"parallel_state", "mpu"}
+BUFFER_FUNCTIONS = {
+    "get_global_memory_buffer",
+    "destroy_global_memory_buffer",
+    "_set_global_memory_buffer",
+}
+# Tests are not scanned: they exercise the parallel_state aliases on purpose.
+SCANNED_FOLDERS = ("megatron", "examples", "tools")
+
+
+def parallel_state_buffer_uses(source, package):
+    """Return the lines that take a buffer function from parallel_state.
+
+    ``package`` is the dotted package of the scanned file, used to resolve relative imports. A
+    name bound to the parallel_state module anywhere in the file counts in every scope.
+    """
+    tree = ast.parse(source)
+    modules = set()
+    lines = []
+    for node in ast.walk(tree):
+        if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
+            modules.update(a.asname for a in node.names if a.name == PARALLEL_STATE and a.asname)
+        elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom):
+            module = node.module or ""
+            if node.level:
+                module = importlib.util.resolve_name("." * node.level + module, package)
+            for alias in node.names:
+                if module == PARALLEL_STATE and alias.name in BUFFER_FUNCTIONS:
+                    lines.append(node.lineno)
+                elif module == "megatron.core" and alias.name in PARALLEL_STATE_NAMES:
+                    modules.add(alias.asname or alias.name)
+    for node in ast.walk(tree):
+        if isinstance(node, ast.Attribute) and node.attr in BUFFER_FUNCTIONS:
+            owner = node.value
+            if (isinstance(owner, ast.Name) and owner.id in modules) or (
+                ast.unparse(owner) == PARALLEL_STATE
+            ):
+                lines.append(node.lineno)
+    return sorted(lines)
+
+
+class TestParallelStateBufferUses(unittest.TestCase):
+    """The scan finds every spelling of the parallel_state aliases and nothing else."""
+
+    PACKAGE = "megatron.core.transformer"
+
+    def test_detects_parallel_state_aliases(self):
+        cases = [
+            ("from megatron.core.parallel_state import get_global_memory_buffer\n", [1]),
+            (
+                "from megatron.core.parallel_state import (\n"
+                "    destroy_model_parallel,\n"
+                "    destroy_global_memory_buffer,\n"
+                ")\n",
+                [1],
+            ),
+            ("from ..parallel_state import get_global_memory_buffer\n", [1]),
+            (
+                "from megatron.core import parallel_state\n"
+                "parallel_state.get_global_memory_buffer().get_tensor(shape, dtype, 'mpu')\n",
+                [2],
+            ),
+            ("from megatron.core import mpu\nmpu.destroy_global_memory_buffer()\n", [2]),
+            ("from .. import parallel_state as ps\nps._set_global_memory_buffer()\n", [2]),
+            ("import megatron.core.parallel_state as grid\ngrid.get_global_memory_buffer()\n", [2]),
+            (
+                "import megatron.core.parallel_state\n"
+                "megatron.core.parallel_state.get_global_memory_buffer()\n",
+                [2],
+            ),
+            (
+                "from megatron.core import parallel_state\n"
+                "def f():\n    return parallel_state.get_global_memory_buffer()\n",
+                [3],
+            ),
+        ]
+        for source, lines in cases:
+            with self.subTest(source=source):
+                self.assertEqual(parallel_state_buffer_uses(source, self.PACKAGE), lines)
+
+    def test_ignores_the_core_buffer_and_unrelated_buffers(self):
+        cases = [
+            "from megatron.core.utils import get_global_memory_buffer\nget_global_memory_buffer()\n",
+            "from megatron.core import utils\nutils.destroy_global_memory_buffer()\n",
+            "from ..utils import destroy_global_memory_buffer, get_global_memory_buffer\n",
+            "from .utils import get_global_memory_buffer\n",
+            "from megatron.core import parallel_state\n"
+            "parallel_state.destroy_model_parallel()\n"
+            "fsdp_utils.get_global_memory_buffer()\n",
+        ]
+        for source in cases:
+            with self.subTest(source=source):
+                self.assertEqual(parallel_state_buffer_uses(source, self.PACKAGE), [])
+
+
+class TestInTreeBufferUses(unittest.TestCase):
+    """Library, example and tool code use megatron.core.utils for the global memory buffer."""
+
+    def test_in_tree_code_uses_the_core_buffer(self):
+        paths = [path for folder in SCANNED_FOLDERS for path in (REPO_ROOT / folder).rglob("*.py")]
+        paths.extend(REPO_ROOT.glob("*.py"))
+        violations = []
+        for path in sorted(paths):
+            relative = path.relative_to(REPO_ROOT)
+            package = ".".join(relative.parent.parts)
+            source = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+            for line in parallel_state_buffer_uses(source, package):
+                violations.append(f"{relative}:{line}")
+        self.assertEqual(violations, [])
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
